desc: Parse input and separate fixed values from wildcards (-1) in both sequences A and B.
Generate candidate target sums S from pairs of fixed values (A_i + B_j) and handle edge cases where one sequence is entirely wildcards.
For each candidate S, check if fixed elements can be matched (A_i needs B_j = S - A_i) using frequency counts.
Verify that remaining unmatched fixed elements can be paired with wildcards, ensuring non-negativity constraints are met.
Implement an efficient matching algorithm (e.g., greedy with sorting or multiset) to validate feasibility for each candidate S.
Output "Yes" if any candidate S works, otherwise "No".
Write final code with K = max(a_fixed + b_fixed - N, 0) simplification and dictionary-based f(s) computation, ensuring early termination when f(s) ≥ K.
Optimize M(S) computation to a single O(D_A·D_B) aggregation pass (dict accumulation of min(ca,cb) per sum, skip S < T, early Yes when any reaches K); verified against all three samples.
